Mutiny Plot : Cole Reed was in the Special Forces and served as a New York police officer in a former life. Now working private security, Reed is framed for murdering his Thai billionaire friend, Tibu, and he comes across an international conspiracy in his search for the true killer.

Mutiny is an upcoming action thriller film directed by Jean-François Richet and written by Lindsay Michel and J. P. Davis. It stars Jason Statham, Annabelle Wallis and Jason Wong. Produced by Punch Palace Productions and MadRiver Pictures, the film is set to be released by Lionsgate Films in the United States in August 21, 2026.
